title: It's ok seems soft and ok for cloth couches. Overpriced though.
text: It's ok seems soft and ok for cloth couches. Overpriced though.. I'm not real impressed with this and bought a nicer cover for less money but it wasn't available. This is soft and came with two foam bars to help hold it down. I'm using it on a cloth couch so it should stay. It doesn't seem waterproof like the other one and it's thinner. I think it will fit well though. It does have a foam back so I won't run it through the dryer long.
